changes:
**New in 0.52.8**
- **See your highlights while text is selected.** In Read mode, highlighted text keeps its yellow background. A thin outline shows which highlighted text you’ve selected, so you can see both the highlight and the selection at once.
- **Keep the caret visible while editing a divider.** The caret stays at body-text height when you edit a Markdown divider (`---`). When you move the caret away, the divider displays as a line again.
